arxiv-1911-11025.title: Women, politics and Twitter: Using machine learning to change the discourse
arxiv-1911-11025.creator: Lana Cuthberston, Alex Kearney, Riley Dawson, Ashia Zawaduk, Eve Cuthbertson, Ann Gordon-Tighe, Kory W Mathewson
arxiv-1911-11025.description: Abstract Including diverse voices in political decision-making strengthens our democratic institutions. Within the Canadian political system, there is gender inequality across all levels of elected government. Online abuse, such as hateful tweets, leveled at women engaged in politics contributes to this inequity, particularly tweets focusing on their gender.

arxiv-2112-01549.title: Application of a Steady-State Accretion Disk Model to Spectrophotometry and High-Resolution Spectra of Two Recent FU Ori Outbursts
arxiv-2112-01549.creator: Antonio C. Rodriguez, Lynne A. Hillenbrand
arxiv-2112-01549.description: Abstract We apply a conventional accretion disk model to the FU Ori-type objects HBC 722 and Gaia 17bpi. Our base model is a steady-state, thin Keplerian disk featuring a modified Shakura-Sunyaev temperature profile, with each annulus radiating as an area-weighted spectrum given by a NextGen atmosphere at the appropriate temperature.

arxiv-2303-12853.title: Three iterations of ( d − 1 ) (d-1) -WL test distinguish non-isometric clouds of d d -dimensional points
arxiv-2303-12853.creator: Valentino Delle Rose, Alexander Kozachinskiy, Cristóbal Rojas, Mircea Petrache, Pablo Barceló
arxiv-2303-12853.description: Abstract The Weisfeiler–Lehman (WL) test is a fundamental iterative algorithm for checking isomorphism of graphs. It has also been observed that it underlies the design of several graph neural network architectures, whose capabilities and performance can be understood in terms of the expressive power of this test.

arxiv-2306-09489.title: The 2023 Video Similarity Dataset and Challenge
arxiv-2306-09489.creator: Ed Pizzi 1 and Giorgos Kordopatis-Zilos 2 and Hiral Patel 1 and Gheorghe Postelnicu 1 and Sugosh Nagavara Ravindra 1 and Akshay Gupta 1 and Symeon Papadopoulos 3 and Giorgos Tolias 2 and Matthijs Douze 1 1 Meta AI, San Francisco, Menlo Park, London, Paris 2 VRG, FEE, Czech Technical University in Pr
arxiv-2306-09489.description: Abstract This work introduces a dataset, benchmark, and challenge for the problem of video copy detection and localization. The problem comprises two distinct but related tasks: determining whether a query video shares content with a reference video (‘‘detection’’), and additionally temporally localizing the shared content within each video (‘‘localization’’).

arxiv-2310-12310.title: Overview of the EUSO-SPB2 Target of Opportunity program using the Cherenkov Telescope
arxiv-2310-12310.creator: Tonia M. Venters
arxiv-2310-12310.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tonia M. Venters. During the Extreme Universe Space Observatory on a Super Pressure Balloon 2 (EUSO-SPB2) mission, we planned Target of Opportunity (ToO) operations to follow up on possible sources of ≳ 10 ​ PeV \gtrsim 10\,{\rm PeV} neutrinos. The original plan before flight was to point the onboard Cherenkov Telescope (CT) to catch the source’s path on the sky just below Earth’s horizon.

arxiv-2501-17726.title: VICCA : Visual Interpretation and Comprehension of Chest X-ray Anomalies in Generated Report Without Human Feedback
arxiv-2501-17726.creator: Sayeh GHOLIPOUR PICHA, Dawood AL CHANTI, Alice CAPLIER
arxiv-2501-17726.description: Abstract As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly central to healthcare, the demand for explainable and trustworthy models is paramount. Current report generation systems for chest X-rays (CXR) often lack mechanisms for validating outputs without expert oversight, raising concerns about reliability and interpretability.

arxiv-2505-17267.title: GreekBarBench : A Challenging Benchmark for Free-Text Legal Reasoning and Citations
arxiv-2505-17267.creator: Odysseas S. Chlapanis Dimitrios Galanis Nikolaos Aletras Ion Androutsopoulos
arxiv-2505-17267.description: Abstract We introduce GreekBarBench , a benchmark that evaluates LLMs on legal questions across five different legal areas from the Greek Bar exams, requiring citations to statutory articles and case facts. To tackle the challenges of free-text evaluation, we propose a three-dimensional scoring system combined with an LLM-as-a-judge approach.

arxiv-2507-01200.title: A Novel Intensity-Based Criterion for Determining Exceptional Point in PT-Symmetry Coupled Array of Optical Waveguides
arxiv-2507-01200.creator: Mahla Bahar, Mojtaba Golshani, Mostafa Motamedifar
arxiv-2507-01200.description: Abstract In this study, we investigated the propagation pattern and the site-to-site correlation function in a PT-symmetric waveguide array with different input quantum states. Recognizing the stark difference in propagation pattern before and after the PT symmetry-breaking point, we have developed a novel, straightforward intensity-based criterion to determine the exceptional point (EP).

arxiv-2601-22390.title: An Effective Energy Mask-based Adversarial Evasion Attacks against Misclassification in Speaker Recognition Systems
arxiv-2601-22390.creator: Chanwoo Park, Chanwoo Kim
arxiv-2601-22390.description: Abstract Evasion attacks pose significant threats to AI systems, exploiting vulnerabilities in machine learning models to bypass detection mechanisms. The widespread use of voice data, including deepfakes, in promising future industries is currently hindered by insufficient legal frameworks. Adversarial attack methods have emerged as the most effective countermeasure against the indiscriminate use of such data.

pmc-11439954.description: It is uncertain whether the prognostic power of white matter hyperintensity (WMH) on post-stroke outcomes is modulated as a function of initial neurological severity, a critical determinant of outcome after stroke. pmc-11710770.creator: Pierre Dourlen, Erwan Lambert, Alejandra Freire‐Regatillo, Carla Gelle, Valentin Leclerc, Nicolas Barois, Xavier Hermant, Tommy Malfoi, Patrik Verstreken, Philippe Amouyel, Frank Lafont, Devrim Kilinc, Jean‐Charles Lambert
pmc-11710770.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background BIN1 is a major susceptibility gene for AD and BIN1 protein interacts with Tau. However, the contribution of BIN1 and its isoforms to AD pathogenesis remains unclear. We recently described that human BIN1 isoform1 (BIN1iso1) induces an accumulation of early endosome vesicles leading to neurodegeneration in Drosophila retina and that the early endosome size regulation was conserved in human induced neurons. This role was specific to BIN1iso1, as compared to BIN1iso8 and BIN1iso9.
